name: Smart Parking Controller
tagline: Control a live garage, not a static parking list.
brief: Coordinate arrivals, occupied bays, and physical exits while traffic continues.
context: Each tick makes one decision while cars already in the facility keep moving and occupying resources.
narrative:
You are joining ParkFlow's facility-control team. Vehicles arrive with standard, electric, large, VIP, accessible, and reservation requirements.

Parking consumes a shared movement lane, and a car is not parked immediately after allocation. Exit requests also keep their bays occupied until the controller authorises the physical exit. Vehicles have limited patience, so ignoring departures can block the entire facility.
objective: Serve the visible shift without hard violations or abandonment, then submit a policy that passes the hidden operations suite.
learningObjective: Coordinate two queues and reusable capacity while decisions and physical work happen asynchronously.
intelligenceExplanation:
The interview starts with an empty rule set. Build the policy from the facility contract.

Handle hard eligibility first, coordinate exit capacity with entrance work, and use preference fallbacks only when they remain safe and fair.
hint: Check exit-gate availability first, then reserved/accessibility/large requirements, then premium and charging preferences, and finally standard parking.
hints: Exit requests still occupy bays. Release them when both the exit gate and lane are available.
Reserved, accessible, and large requirements are hard constraints; VIP and charging placement are scored preferences.
Use carPatienceRemaining and congestion before deciding whether to wait for a preferred category or use a valid fallback.

steps.label: Protect reserved, accessible, large, and occupied-space constraints
Keep exit turnover running while arrivals continue
Resolve the visible shift with no abandonment or hard violation
Submit the same controller to the hidden interview suite

objectives.label: No vehicle abandons the entrance queue

rubric: Generalization across hidden layouts and events: 15%

goals.description: Operate the facility safely and continuously.

states.description: Reassess both queues and facility capacity every tick.

functions.description: Assign the head arrival to a standard bay.
Assign the head arrival to a charging bay.
Assign the head arrival to a large bay.
Assign the head arrival to a premium bay.
Assign the head arrival to an accessible bay.
Assign the head reserved arrival to its matching reserved bay.
Start the oldest ready vehicle's physical exit.
Take no new action while facility work advances.
